Definition: dative case plural masculine or neuter of G3778; to (for, in, with or by) these (persons or things):--such, them, there(-in, -with), these, this, those.
BiblicalUsage: To these, by these, in these — the plural of the same pointing word. Abraham says between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, Paul says in all these things we are more than conquerors, and he warns that those who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cases are gathered together here: these things, all of them, and the verdict that covers them all.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
